ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✓ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 ✗
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

caveats: Risk cone (drawdown/vol) is the validated read; DIRECTION is display-only (measured coin-flip).
Cone widens with horizon; downside tail is the forecastable left side.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

headline.en: Short-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime → rate tailwind.
headline.zh: 短久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境→利率顺风。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.91 ± 0.20 — high precision. Sector anchor (XLE) reads short-duration (-0.60). Inflation hedge.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.91 ± 0.20——精度高。 板块锚（XLE）为短久期（-0.60）。 通胀对冲。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

headline.zh: 鲸鱼拥挤 — 谨防回吐

detail.en: High DannyTrades composite / hot-and-rising accumulation — historically this is where forward returns fade. Don't chase; wait for a reset.
detail.zh: DannyTrades 综合分偏高 / 吸筹过热且上升 — 历史上正是未来回报转弱之处。勿追高，等待回落。

caveat.en: Contrarian read — the INVERSE of the indicator's usual framing. Validated (display-only) that a high composite flags lower forward-63d returns (decile Spearman −0.88) and that rising 'whale accumulation' precedes under-performance (monthly IC t≈−3.9). Large-cap survivor sample; a tilt, not a trade.
caveat.zh: 逆向解读 — 与该指标常规用法相反。经验证（仅供展示）：高综合分预示未来63日回报更低（分位单调 Spearman −0.88），且“鲸鱼吸筹”上升反而领先跑输（月度 IC t≈−3.9）。样本为大盘幸存股；是倾斜而非交易信号。
